body:
This should mention `MAKE_RESOURCE_TYPE_HINT`, which is used to generate hint strings in most cases.

As well as full hit string format:
`vformat("%s/%s:%s", Variant::TYPE, PROPERTY_HINT_XXX, "hint_string")`.
